mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, s.seat_id AS seatId, s.seat_row AS seatRow, s.seat_colume AS seatColume, s.grade, r.reserved_status AS status FROM RESERVATIONS r JOIN SEATS s ON r.seat_id = s.seat_id WHERE r.round_id = #{roundId} ORDER BY s.seat_row, s.seat_colume
SELECT seat_id AS seatId, seat_row AS seatRow, seat_colume AS seatColume, grade FROM SEATS WHERE seat_id = #{seatId}
